answer: Continuous acoustic room fingerprint enrollment. Each agent identity must embed a live microphone challenge: the operator's unique room impulse response, captured through a physical echo profile of their space. The vault stores only the transformed fingerprint, never raw audio. To register another identity, an attacker must physically occupy and acoustically characterize a distinct room; a dune of cloned VMs in one datacenter shares one impulse response and collapses to a single identity. Per-identity cost: one real acoustic environment.
